versions.name: Camp Hugh Taylor Birch

features.note: Campfire programme is held at the Council Ring.
A 30-foot tower with three climbing sides and one rappelling side.
Project COPE runs from ground initiative games up to a high ropes course.
Scouts engage interactive targets with .22 rifles, shotguns, and pistols on a themed range.
A disc golf course laid out around camp; discs are issued at the camp office.
Tecumseh Island, the first-year camper program based at Cargill Pavilion.
Fishing on Bud Martin Lake, outside the waterfront area.
Multiple geocaches around camp; coordinates come from the outdoor skills area director.
Handicraft is based in the Kiwanis Lodge.
Mad River Trace, a multi-year progressive frontier skills program covering primitive fire making, leather craft, and tomahawk throwing.
The nature center is housed in the Chaplain's Cabin.
Trail to Eagle, a program area for older Scouts working Eagle-required merit badges.
Outpost camping is a requirement of the Mad River Trace program.
Small-boat sailing on the camp lake.
The Tech Center in the Adams Building is the camp's STEM hub.
Tomahawk throwing is taught in the Mad River Trace program.
The lakefront is the base for all boating programme.
Welding merit badge is offered in the skill trades evening program.

versions.summary: Tecumseh Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Yellow Springs, Ohio, also serving Cub Scout day and resident programs.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
